title: Psalm 134: A Blessing for the Night Watch
summary: The last of the Songs of Ascents calls the servants of the LORD who stand in his house by night to lift their hands and bless him. In the final verse the blessing turns around: the worshipers who have blessed the LORD are themselves blessed by him, the Maker of heaven and earth, from Zion.

line: The last Song of Ascents calls the LORD's servants who stand in his house by night to lift their hands and bless him, and blesses them in return.
guide: Some service is done at night, unseen: a parent with a sick child, a nurse on a late shift, someone praying awake. God sees night work, and it can be worship. Speak the blessing of verse 3 over someone else.

stanzas.title: The call to the night servants: bless the LORD

verses.t: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
